messages:
Asha (CS): Kicking off AnchorPoint private/VPC handoff. They confirmed VPC peering and TGW attachment but we still need final KMS key policy, IAM cross-account role, and audit log ingestion path. Also flagged renewal risk if go-live slips past Apr 12 — they asked for an exec update.
Connor (Solutions): Thanks. Quick 🧭 overview: we asked AnchorPoint for the peering CIDRs and the account ID. They gave the account (123456789012) and CIDR ranges. Missing from their side: flow logs to S3, lifecycle rules, and an s3 prefix for audit ingestion.
Lena (Infra Eng): On the infra side I need the KMS key policy specifically allowing our cross-account role and also to confirm whether they want CMK rotation enabled. If rotation = true we need to document rotation windows.
Connor (Solutions): Here's the trust policy we agreed to — please check and paste into the role in their account:

```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/AnchorPoint-Deploy"},
      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
    }
  ]
}
```

Asha (CS): Good. Connor, can you also confirm the list of CloudTrail event selectors we recommended for audit-grade logs? AnchorPoint asked if we can send a minimal set.
Connor (Solutions): Minimal recommended: management events (ReadOnly and Write), S3 data events for the audit bucket, and KMS key usage events. I'll DM the exact list but posting the high-level here.
Lena (Infra Eng): KMS sample policy for the CMK (customer-managed) — include this so their Security team can review:

```
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[
    {
      "Sid":"AllowUseFromRedwood",
      "Effect":"Allow",
      "Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::999888777666:role/redwood-serve-role"},
      "Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey","kms:DescribeKey"],
      "Resource":"*"
    }
  ]
}
```

Evan (SE): Scheduling note — AnchorPoint asked for a 60min enablement session covering secrets/KMS, audit pipeline, and failover. Proposed Wed 3pm PT. I can demo how we ingest CloudTrail -> S3 -> Splunk and show SLO rollback behavior.
Asha (CS): Wed 3pm PT works for them. Please include a short runbook for rotating keys and emergency rotate rollback steps. Also capture feedback questions: what concerns do they have about key ownership, and do they need HSM/KMS hybrid?
cs-onboard-bot: Checklist updated — added: KMS policy file uploaded to /projects/anchorpoint/configs/kms-policy.json, IAM trust policy attached, audit-log-spec v1.2 added. Assignee: Lena (Infra Eng). :white_check_mark:
Lena (Infra Eng): I'll finish the IAM role creation docs and the route table diagram. Two quick asks for AnchorPoint: can they enable VPC Flow Logs for the TGW attachment and set a 90-day S3 lifecycle for logs?
Asha (CS): I'll relay those asks. Also note: renewal risk = medium until we hit go-live. If delivery slips beyond Apr 12 I'll escalate to AM and request exec touch. For now keep CS weekly check-ins.
Connor (Solutions): I'll send the CloudTrail selectors + example S3 bucket policy and validate CORS/ACLs aren't blocking Splunk ingestion.
Evan (SE): One more thing — audit samples: can they produce a 48-hr sample export from their current environment so we can validate parsing? If yes, ask them to upload to the bucket prefix: s3://redwood-audit-ingest/anchorpoint/sample/
Asha (CS): Good call. I'll ask them to upload by EOD tomorrow. If they can't, we'll schedule a quick remote session to capture events.
Lena (Infra Eng): Plan: by EOD tomorrow I will (1) publish final KMS policy, (2) push IAM role manifest to their account, (3) draw updated route table/TGW map. Then we can run the Splunk ingestion smoke test on Thurs.
Asha (CS): Perfect — thanks team. I'll prep the renewal notes and include the enablement invite. We'll reconvene after the smoke test. :calendar:
